tokens.name: background-canvas
tokens.usage: background.canvas. The page ground. Groups of content sit on it in background-surface; the step between the two tones is what separates them, not a border.

tokens.name: background-surface
tokens.usage: background.surface. Groups of related content on the canvas: lists, tables, form sections, panels. No shadow; no outline except border-group.

tokens.name: background-elevated
tokens.usage: background.elevated. Popovers, dialogs, sheets, dragged items. Always paired with a shadow token; in dark the lighter tone carries the layering.

tokens.name: background-watch
tokens.usage: Canvas of watch screens in every theme: true black, which the display and battery favour. Content on it uses the dark theme's text and accent values.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: text.primary. Headings, body copy and data on background-canvas, background-surface and background-elevated.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: text.secondary. Labels, captions and supporting copy on background-canvas, background-surface and background-elevated. Never the label of an enabled control.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: text.disabled. Disabled control labels only. Deliberately below 4.5:1; never use for readable content or placeholders that carry meaning.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: border.subtle. Hairline dividers between rows inside a group, inset to the text edge. Not for outlining groups or controls.

tokens.name: border-group
tokens.usage: 1px outline of a background-surface group. Invisible in light and dark, where tone separates the group from the canvas; visible in high contrast, where canvas and surface are the same white.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: border.strong. Input and control outlines that must be perceivable (3:1 on all three backgrounds).

tokens.name: accent-default
tokens.usage: accent.default. Primary action fill, active selection, meaningful emphasis; as link text on all three backgrounds. Never on large unrelated surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: accent.hover. Hover state of accent-default fills.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: accent.pressed. Pressed/active state of accent-default fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-default, accent-hover and accent-pressed. Added to the source roles so dark mode keeps contrast on the lightened accent.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: status.success. Text and icons on all three backgrounds. Always paired with a word or icon; never told apart from error by hue alone.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: status.warning. Text and icons on all three backgrounds, always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: status.error. Field errors, destructive emphasis, global failures; text and icons on all three backgrounds, always with a message.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: status.info. Neutral notices on all three backgrounds, always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: focus.ring. Solid 2px focus-visible outline with 2px offset; at least 3:1 on every background.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Overlay on any background for hover of neutral rows, menu items and ghost controls.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Overlay for the pressed state of neutral rows and controls.

tokens.name: state-selected
tokens.usage: Background of the selected or current row, tab or item; text-primary on top. Pair with a non-color cue (weight, indicator or icon).

tokens.name: status-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a success notice. text-primary on it, with status-success for the icon or a short label (4.5:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: status-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a warning notice. text-primary on it, with status-warning for the icon or a short label (4.5:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: status-error-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of an error notice or invalid region. text-primary on it, with status-error for the icon or a short label (4.5:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: status-info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of an informational notice. text-primary on it, with status-info for the icon or a short label (4.5:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First or highlighted series. Marks on background-canvas and background-surface (3:1). Use in order; beyond five series, group or facet. Add a direct label or pattern, never hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series. Marks on background-canvas and background-surface (3:1). Use in order; beyond five series, group or facet. Add a direct label or pattern, never hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series. Marks on background-canvas and background-surface (3:1). Use in order; beyond five series, group or facet. Add a direct label or pattern, never hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series. Marks on background-canvas and background-surface (3:1). Use in order; beyond five series, group or facet. Add a direct label or pattern, never hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series, baselines and 'other'. Marks on background-canvas and background-surface (3:1). Use in order; beyond five series, group or facet. Add a direct label or pattern, never hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines and axes; always subordinate to the data.

tokens.name: user-1
tokens.usage: User palette, blue. A color a user can give to a team or category; mark on dark surfaces (3:1 or more on black), black text on it, 1px border-strong outline on light surfaces. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: user-2
tokens.usage: User palette, orange. A color a user can give to a team or category; mark on dark surfaces (3:1 or more on black), black text on it, 1px border-strong outline on light surfaces. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: user-3
tokens.usage: User palette, lime. A color a user can give to a team or category; mark on dark surfaces (3:1 or more on black), black text on it, 1px border-strong outline on light surfaces. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: user-4
tokens.usage: User palette, teal. A color a user can give to a team or category; mark on dark surfaces (3:1 or more on black), black text on it, 1px border-strong outline on light surfaces. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: user-5
tokens.usage: User palette, pink. A color a user can give to a team or category; mark on dark surfaces (3:1 or more on black), black text on it, 1px border-strong outline on light surfaces. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: user-6
tokens.usage: User palette, amber. A color a user can give to a team or category; mark on dark surfaces (3:1 or more on black), black text on it, 1px border-strong outline on light surfaces. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: user-7
tokens.usage: User palette, violet. A color a user can give to a team or category; mark on dark surfaces (3:1 or more on black), black text on it, 1px border-strong outline on light surfaces. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: user-8
tokens.usage: User palette, white. A color a user can give to a team or category; mark on dark surfaces (3:1 or more on black), black text on it, 1px border-strong outline on light surfaces. Same in every theme.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Only where the product context justifies it; never inside operational tools.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, control labels, column headers.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Changing metrics and table values compared vertically. Always set tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) and right-align.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline pairs.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a component.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Control padding, compact row padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Default padding; gap between related controls; page gutter on narrow viewports.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a region.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between regions.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Gap between major sections in balanced layouts.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Editorial layouts only; not inside operational tools.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, selection indicators.

tokens.name: radius-surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels that have a structural reason to exist. Inner radii stay smaller than outer.

tokens.name: radius-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only truly pill-shaped controls: switches, avatars, a segmented indicator. Not buttons or badges by default.

shadow.note: Elevation only explains layering. Static surfaces take no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Popovers, floating controls, sticky surfaces over scrolling content, dragged items.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets on background-elevated.

duration.note: Starting points; refine through use while keeping the role names.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, colour and border changes.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, small opacity changes, icon state changes.

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: Popovers, tab content, fade-through, layout changes.

tokens.name: duration-expressive
tokens.usage: Large container transforms only.

tokens.name: duration-spring-control
tokens.usage: Settle time of ease-spring-control; use the two together.

tokens.name: duration-spring-surface
tokens.usage: Settle time of ease-spring-surface; use the two together.

tokens.name: duration-spring-expressive
tokens.usage: Settle time of ease-spring-expressive; use the two together.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for opacity, colour, border and anything that must not overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Elements entering.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving.

tokens.name: ease-spring-control
tokens.usage: Spring 'control' (stiffness 520, damping 38, mass 0.7) as a CSS linear() curve; always with duration-spring-control. Small spatial moves: selection indicators, switch thumbs, press feedback. Native platforms use the spring parameters directly.

tokens.name: ease-spring-surface
tokens.usage: Spring 'surface' (stiffness 360, damping 30, mass 0.9) as a CSS linear() curve; always with duration-spring-surface. Panels, sheets, container transforms, list reordering. Native platforms use the spring parameters directly. Settles with a barely visible overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-spring-expressive
tokens.usage: Spring 'expressive' (stiffness 280, damping 26, mass 0.9) as a CSS linear() curve; always with duration-spring-expressive. Rare large transformations; overshoots slightly, so never for opacity or colour. Native platforms use the spring parameters directly.

tokens.name: icon-compact
tokens.usage: Icons in dense rows and captions.

tokens.name: icon-standard
tokens.usage: Default icon size in controls.

tokens.name: icon-prominent
tokens.usage: Navigation and empty-state icons.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width of every outline icon on the 24px grid, set where the icon is used (CSS stroke-width). Lighter than the files' default 2 so icons sit with 16px regular text.

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Control height in compact density with a pointer.

tokens.name: control-standard
tokens.usage: Default control height, comfortable for pointer and touch.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum target on touch and wearable surfaces.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for paragraphs.

tokens.name: shift-axis
tokens.usage: Travel of a page in a shared-axis transition (forward, back, submenu, step). Short on purpose: it says 'next' without the eye following a whole page.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: Below: single column, bottom navigation or sheet patterns.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: From here: two regions, side panel becomes possible.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: From here: persistent navigation and contextual side panel.

breakpoint.note: Window width classes. Define per component what wraps, stacks or moves at each.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and toolbars.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim, dialogs, sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Transient status messages.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled icons and media. Disabled text uses text-disabled instead.

layout.note: Fluid layout values. Prefer these continuous values to switching fixed sizes at breakpoints.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right page margin. Grows with the viewport; inside a container use the same formula with cqw.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a page's content column; beyond it the margins grow, not the content.

tokens.name: pane-list
tokens.usage: Comfortable width of a list or navigation pane next to a detail pane.

tokens.name: pane-side
tokens.usage: Width of a contextual side or detail pane once there is room for it.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the navigation rail that replaces the bottom bar on wide windows.

scale.note: Scale factors used by transitions. Plain numbers.

tokens.name: scale-press
tokens.usage: Any control while pressed, with opacity 0.85.

tokens.name: scale-popover
tokens.usage: Starting scale of menus, popovers and dialogs as they open from their origin.

tokens.name: scale-page
tokens.usage: Starting scale of the incoming page in a fade-through between top-level destinations.

tokens.name: scale-back
tokens.usage: Smallest scale of the current page while a predictive back gesture is dragged.

tokens.name: scale-lift
tokens.usage: An item lifted by long press or picked up to drag, with shadow-floating.
